## About TinyOpt
TinyOpt is a free, open-source Windows desktop batch image compressor powered by the TinyPNG API. Bulk compress PNG, JPEG, WebP, and AVIF; add watermarks; convert formats; and rename files in bulk — without browser upload queues or file-size caps.

## Core Features
- Batch image compression (PNG, JPEG, WebP, AVIF, BMP, GIF, TIFF)
- Visual watermark editor with drag-and-drop positioning (image + text watermarks)
- 9 output formats including ICO and PDF
- Batch rename with variable templates ({name}, {index}, {date})
- Multi-API-key management with auto-rotation and quota tracking
- Image aspect ratio adjustment (crop, pad, stretch with presets)
- Compression history with detailed records

## FAQ
### Is TinyOpt free?
Yes. The desktop app is free and open source. You need a TinyPNG API key (free tier: 500 images/month) for API compression.

### What image formats are supported?
Input: PNG, JPEG, WebP, AVIF, BMP, GIF, TIFF. Output: JPEG, PNG, WebP, GIF, TIFF, BMP, AVIF, ICO, PDF (9 formats).

### Are my images uploaded to TinyOpt servers?
No. Desktop compression sends images only to TinyPNG's official API over HTTPS. Online tools on this site process images in the browser; they are not uploaded to TinyOpt servers.

### Does compression reduce image quality?
TinyPNG uses smart lossy compression that usually cuts file size 50–80% with little visible quality loss. You can also adjust settings.

### How do I get a TinyPNG API Key?
Register at https://tinypng.com/developers for a free key (500 compressions/month).

### Does it support batch processing?
Yes. Drag multiple images or entire folders; multi-threaded batch compression is supported.

## Technical Information
- Tech Stack: Python 3.12 + PyQt5 + Pillow + TinyPNG API
- Platform: Windows 10/11 desktop application
- License: Open source, free to use
- API: TinyPNG/TinyJPG official API for compression
- Download: https://github.com/SinMu-L/TinyOpt/releases/latest/download/TinyOpt-latest.exe
- GitHub: https://github.com/SinMu-L/TinyOpt

## Source Code (desktop app)
- main.py — main window entry
- core/config.py — config and constants
- core/key_manager.py — API key pool and rotation
- core/pages/compress_page.py — batch compression
- core/pages/watermark_page.py — watermark tool
- core/pages/rename_page.py — batch rename
- core/pages/ratio_page.py — aspect ratio tool
- core/pages/website_page.py — webpage screenshot
- core/pages/history_page.py — compression history
- core/pages/key_page.py — API key management UI
